import ctypes
import numpy as np

def cblas_ccopy(N, X, incX, Y, incY):
    # Load libraries in the correct order
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    # Define the cblas_ccopy function signature
    # Note: cblas_ccopy is part of libgslcblas, not libgsl
    cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so")
    cblas.cblas_ccopy.argtypes = [
        ctypes.c_int,                # N
        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float),  # X (complex numbers as float pairs)
        ctypes.c_int,                # incX
        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float),  # Y (complex numbers as float pairs)
        ctypes.c_int                 # incY
    ]
    cblas.cblas_ccopy.restype = None

    # Call the cblas_ccopy function
    cblas.cblas_ccopy(N, ctypes.cast(X, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), incX, ctypes.cast(Y, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), incY)

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Basic functionality
    N = 3
    X_np = np.array([1+2j, 3+4j, 5+6j], dtype=np.complex64)
    Y_np = np.zeros(3, dtype=np.complex64)

    X = (ctypes.c_float * (2 * N))(*np.ravel(X_np.view(np.float32)))
    Y = (ctypes.c_float * (2 * N))(*np.ravel(Y_np.view(np.float32)))

    cblas_ccopy(N, X, 1, Y, 1)

    # Convert back to numpy array for comparison
    Y_result = np.frombuffer(Y, dtype=np.float32).view(np.complex64)
    assert np.allclose(Y_result, X_np), f"Test case 1 failed: {Y_result} != {X_np}"

    # Test case 2: Stride functionality
    N = 2
    X_np = np.array([1+2j, 3+4j, 5+6j], dtype=np.complex64)
    Y_np = np.zeros(2, dtype=np.complex64)

    X = (ctypes.c_float * (2 * len(X_np)))(*np.ravel(X_np.view(np.float32)))
    Y = (ctypes.c_float * (2 * N))(*np.ravel(Y_np.view(np.float32)))

    cblas_ccopy(N, X, 2, Y, 1)

    Y_result = np.frombuffer(Y, dtype=np.float32).view(np.complex64)
    expected = np.array([1+2j, 5+6j], dtype=np.complex64)
    assert np.allclose(Y_result, expected), f"Test case 2 failed: {Y_result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 3: Edge case with N=0
    N = 0
    X_np = np.array([], dtype=np.complex64)
    Y_np = np.array([], dtype=np.complex64)

    X = (ctypes.c_float * 0)(*np.ravel(X_np.view(np.float32)))
    Y = (ctypes.c_float * 0)(*np.ravel(Y_np.view(np.float32)))

    cblas_ccopy(N, X, 1, Y, 1)

    Y_result = np.frombuffer(Y, dtype=np.float32).view(np.complex64)
    assert np.allclose(Y_result, Y_np), f"Test case 3 failed: {Y_result} != {Y_np}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
